Splitting these paths would create a second resource-admission authority or duplicate prepared-state disposal semantics.

entries.reason: SharedTaskRegistry is one actor state machine covering subscription cohorts, effective priority, completion visibility, orphan handoff leases and cancellation tombstones. Completed entries remain joinable only inside the active cohort and can be explicitly invalidated before a fresh cache-observation transaction. Absolute monotonic expiry and lazy admission checks make timers cleanup optimizations rather than correctness dependencies. Keeping entry, invalidation, tombstone, lease identity, completion and join transitions in one actor preserves the linearization boundary and prevents ABA races.
responsibilities: absolute cancellation tombstone admission and retention

modules.reason: FoveaCore remains the Fovea-owned policy and orchestration layer for request identity, geometry, resource admission, fetch/decode execution, namespace lifecycle, shared work and diagnostics. The new progressive preview file isolates the bounded transport-to-codec relay, shared preview hub and finalization handoff without creating a new public lifecycle or importing FoveaCore authority elsewhere. The 58-file set preserves one-way package dependencies and remains below the reviewed 0.60 source-share ceiling; extraction becomes mandatory when progressive delivery acquires independent persistence, retry or release cadence.
